name: Francis Pringle

events.title: Marriage
events.description: To Mary Clark (1913-2000); matches the 1936 licence no. 1732 already on file

bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Francis (Frank) Pringle a birth date of 19 Aug 1909 at Plymouth and a death date of 25 Nov 1990, with burial in Hanover Twp, Luzerne Co. It records his marriage on 21 Oct 1936 to Mary Clark (1913-2000) and has him in Wilkes-Barre in 1940 (S1). A GenealogyBank obituary index entry for Frank Pringle is attached but was not read.

sources.citation: FamilySearch published tree, Francis Pringle (L5BP-VZT), with attached index entries
